name: Cayman Islands
summary: A British blue ensign with the islands' coat of arms in the fly: a shield with a lion, three green stars on wavy lines, a turtle and a pineapple crest, and the motto 'He hath founded it upon the seas'.
origin: The coat of arms was granted on 14 May 1958. The blue ensign with the arms on a white disc was used until 1999, when the disc was removed and the arms enlarged.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The Union Flag and the lion's field.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: The three stars, for the islands.

symbols.name: Three stars
symbols.description: Green stars edged in gold on blue and white wavy lines.
symbols.meaning: Grand Cayman, Cayman Brac and Little Cayman, rising from the sea.

symbols.name: Lion
symbols.description: A gold lion on red in the chief.

symbols.name: Turtle and pineapple
symbols.description: A green sea turtle above the shield, with a pineapple.
symbols.meaning: The islands' seafaring history and ties to Jamaica.

facts: The Cayman Islands were administered from Jamaica until 1962.
The sea turtle reflects the islands' history of turtle fishing.
clues: A blue ensign with a shield showing three green stars, a lion, a turtle and a pineapple.
Its three stars are three islands rising from the sea.
Its motto comes from a psalm.
